item.title: Best Practices for Jenkins on Kubernetes
item.description: 1. Configure Larger -Xms -Xmx Parameters Jenkins is an orchestration engine written in Java, and it stops the world (STW) during a Full GC. At large build scale, STW can prevent Jenkins from handling new requests. To avoid frequent STW while also increasing concurrency, it is recommended to set a larger heap, -Xms3g -Xmx6g -XX:MaxRAM=6g.
